name: cashbook
notes: Beyond the spec's route list the module adds POST /cashbook/adjustments (BR-1: the dated, owner-approved adjustment that replaces editing an opening balance), POST /cashbook/approval-requests (BR-5: asks the owner to approve a payment or adjustment and returns the approval doc id that recordPayment takes), PUT /cashbook/transactions/:id/tag (BR-7), GET /cashbook/pending and POST /cashbook/pending/:id/record (BR-6: an advance waits here until a cash account is chosen unless the setting cashbook.advance_account_id names one), POST /cashbook/reconciliations/:id/reopen (BR-8: un-reconcile) and the read endpoints for accounts, transactions and reconciliations. Payments need an approved request when the amount is above the setting cashbook.payment_approval_threshold (default 0, so every payment: H-09). expense.posted moves no cash (BR-6), so the module has no handler for it. A transfer reversal reverses both legs. A transaction of a reconciled statement cannot be reversed until the statement is reopened. Tags are free codes until the chart of accounts is editable from the UI (P2-09).
